docs.title: FLEXploDIA Tutorials
docs.text:
FLEXploDIA explores, edits and visualizes spectral libraries, and helps design and validate dia-PASEF methods. Each tab has its own tutorial:

Tab What it is for Library Explorer Statistics and 11 plots for a whole library or one protein Library Editor Convert, annotate, extract and merge libraries Prot./Pep. Cloud Viz. Peptidoforms of a protein in the ion cloud, with fragment fingerprints Method Developer Design Diagonal-PASEF and Slice-PASEF methods PASEF Validator Compare a DDA library with the DIA library a method produced

Online or desktop?

The online version takes libraries up to 50 MB. For larger libraries, download the desktop version from GitHub.
